title: When the barista still gets your name wrong
description: Doug orders, gives his name, spells it: D-O-U-G. "Perfect. Got it!" After the coffee is made: "Coffee for... Dog!" The cup says DOG. Doug looks at the cup, at her innocent smile, back at the cup, takes it and leaves without a word.

versions.notes: DOG close-up, silent ending, visible cup pickup and exit
